questions: how did Dave get into computers?
how did he get into computers?
did Dave have computers as a kid?
did he have computers as a kid?
answers: Dave grew up with technology in the house: a Commodore 64, dot-matrix printers, word processors, early Hewlett-Packard machines, Nintendo, and TI-89 calculators. BASIC on a TI-89 was his first programming language.
Computers were around Dave early. His father taught math and computer science, and by middle school Dave was around early HP machines and TI-89 calculators running BASIC.
Dave got into programming early through the technology around his house, especially TI-89 calculators that ran BASIC.
